common.heroBody: Launch a storefront for your business with cash on delivery, bKash and Bangla support built in.
common.forbiddenBody: Only the store owner can open this page.

auth.sentHint: If an account exists, we sent a 6-digit code to
auth.useOther: Use a different email or number
auth.resent: If an account exists, a new code is on its way.

signup.title: Open your store
signup.phoneHint: A Bangladeshi mobile number, for example 01711000000. We'll text you a code.
signup.resent: A new code is on its way.
signup.storeBody: You can change the names later. The store address can't be changed.

reason.FORMAT: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens (no hyphen at the start or end).
reason.RESERVED: This address is reserved. Pick another one.

onboarding.title: Set up your store

intro.identity: How customers see and reach your store.
intro.branding: Make the store look like your business. You can do this later.

onboarding.finishBody: Check your settings, then launch your store. You can change everything later in Settings.
onboarding.launchedBody: Share this link with your customers:
onboarding.setupInProgressBody: You can use the admin once the owner finishes setting up the store.

settings.title: Store settings
settings.subdomainReadOnly: The store address can't be changed.
settings.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave this tab anyway?

branding.logoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB, at least 128 × 128 px.
branding.contrastWarning: White text on this colour is hard to read (contrast {ratio, number}:1; aim for at least 4.5:1).

payments.walletNote: Customers will send money to this number and enter the transaction ID with their order.
payments.atLeastOne: Keep at least one payment method on.

social.intro: Links shown in your storefront footer, and how your store appears in search results and when shared.
social.whatsappHint: Customers can start a WhatsApp chat with this number.
social.titleHint: Up to {max, number} characters. Leave empty to use the store name.
social.descriptionHint: Up to {max, number} characters. Leave empty to use the tagline.

storefront.comingSoonBody: This store is being set up. Please check back soon.

images.title: Photos
images.hint: Up to {max, number} photos. Phone photos are resized and compressed before upload; the first photo is the cover.
images.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {No more photos can be added} one {# more photo can be added} other {# more photos can be added}}
images.undecodable: This photo can't be read by your browser (often an iPhone HEIC photo). In the camera settings choose "Most compatible" (JPEG), or pick a JPEG/PNG photo.
images.overLimit: Only {max, number} photos per product: this one was not added.
images.colourPhotosHint: Shoppers who pick this colour see this photo.
images.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add photos.

list.title: Products
list.emptyStore: No products yet. Add your first product.

bulk.label: Bulk action
bulk.done: {count, plural, one {# product updated} other {# products updated}}

editor.titleHint: At least one; the other uses the same text if empty.
editor.descriptionHint: Plain text, line breaks kept, up to {max, number} characters.
editor.featured: Show in Featured on the home page
editor.defaultPriceHint: Used for new variants. Change single variants in the table below.
editor.optionsHint: Add size and/or colour; every combination becomes a variant.
editor.variantsHint: {count, plural, one {# variant} other {# variants}}. A sale price must be lower than the price.
editor.skuHint: Leave empty for an automatic SKU.
editor.slugHint: Leave empty to make one from the English title.
editor.duplicated: Copy created as a draft. Check the SKUs and stock.
editor.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
editor.trashConfirm: Move this product to the trash? You can restore it later.

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: Two levels: a category can have sub-categories, but a sub-category can't.
categories.deleteConfirm: {count, plural, =0 {Delete this category?} one {# product is in this category. Delete it anyway? The product becomes uncategorised.} other {# products are in this category. Delete it anyway? They become uncategorised.}}

featured.title: Featured products
featured.hint: Shown first on your store's home page, in this order.
featured.limitReached: The limit of {max, number} featured products is reached.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted products stay here until you restore them or delete them for good.
trash.confirm: Delete "{title}" for good? Its photos are deleted too. This can't be undone.
trash.ownerOnly: Only the store owner can delete for good.
